result.final_text:
## What this letter says
This letter invites you to an eye check for people with diabetes (diabetic eye screening). You need to book your appointment. This test does not diagnose other eye problems. It does not replace your regular eye test at an optician.

## What you need to do
1. Book your appointment by 15 January 2027. Call 01632 960 377.
2. Bring sunglasses if you have them.
3. Bring your glasses or contact lenses.
4. Bring a list of your medicines.
5. Do not drive until your vision is back to normal.
6. Do not use this screening in place of your regular eye test at an optician.

## Dates and medicines
- Book by 15 January 2027. Call 01632 960 377.
- The letter does not name any medicines for you.
- Bring a list of your medicines to the appointment.

## Questions to ask your doctor
- What will happen at my appointment?
- How long will it be until my vision is back to normal?
- When will I get my results?

## When to get urgent help
The letter does not list specific warning signs.

If you are worried and it is not an emergency, call NHS 111. In an emergency, call 999.

---
*This explanation was made by a computer program to help you read your letter. It may contain mistakes. It does not replace your doctor, nurse or pharmacist. Always follow the letter and ask them if anything is unclear.*
